Flat solid background #eff1f5; foreground #4c4f69; accent teal #179299; blue #1e66f5; muted gray #8c8fa1; amber #df8e1d; thin rules #ccd0da; cursor #dc8a78. The main conversation is realistic English. From top to about y=430, show these blocks, with modest vertical gaps:

"Run two investigations in parallel, then have a reviewer compare the findings."

"The reviewer will start when both reports are ready."

"subagent"
"Started lifecycle and packages."
"reviewer is waiting for both reports."

"While they work, I'll check the recovery decision we already agreed on."

"Continue from the subagent's previous workspace and branch."
"If only the worktree directory was removed, restore it from that branch."
"If the required code state cannot be recovered, report the failure."

"I'll check whether recovery can silently fall back to the main directory."
